findings.highlight: as I managed to get about three hours of sleep
findings.evidenceJa: 三時間ほど眠れたのか
findings.governingReading: perhaps I managed around three hours of sleep
findings.explanation: Shirou’s estimate, inferred from his relatively clear head, becomes a factual cause of that clarity.

findings.highlight: As soon as I get up
findings.evidenceJa: 立ち上がろうとした矢先
findings.governingReading: just as I try to stand
findings.explanation: mirror moon completes Shirou’s rise before his foot slips, while the Japanese has the failure interrupt the attempt.

findings.evidenceJa: 左足
findings.governingReading: my left foot
findings.explanation: The first localized loss of sensation is broadened from the foot to the whole leg before Shirou tests the rest of his left side.

findings.highlight: I’d use my arm as a pillow
findings.evidenceJa: 腕を下敷きにしちまって
findings.governingReading: I accidentally slept with my arm pinned underneath me
findings.explanation: An accidental obstruction of circulation becomes an intentional use of the arm as a pillow.

findings.evidenceJa: 手足をレバーで動かすような
findings.governingReading: as though operating my limbs with levers
findings.explanation: The alien mechanical effort of moving his body by levers becomes the modern, more abstract idea of using a controller.

findings.evidenceJa: ベーコンと卵
findings.governingReading: bacon and eggs
findings.explanation: A concrete breakfast ingredient is replaced by a different cured meat.

findings.evidenceJa: できあいのクラムチャウダー
findings.governingReading: prepared, ready-made clam chowder
findings.explanation: The text says the chowder was already prepared, not necessarily that it was instant powder.

findings.evidenceJa: なんとか食卓を彩ってみる
findings.governingReading: somehow manage to give the breakfast table a little color
findings.explanation: Shirou’s effort to make a limited bread breakfast presentable disappears into a headcount.

findings.evidenceJa: きつね色のトースト
findings.governingReading: golden-brown toast
findings.explanation: The appetizing color of the toast disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 茶碗と箸を持つセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber holding a rice bowl and chopsticks
findings.explanation: Half the contrasting Japanese place-setting image is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 味がある
findings.governingReading: has its own charm
findings.explanation: Shirou’s aesthetic fondness for Saber using Japanese tableware becomes detached curiosity.

findings.evidenceJa: カフェ・マルリー風
findings.governingReading: French cuisine in the style of the Café Marly
findings.explanation: Shirou’s mock-specific cosmopolitan elaboration of Taiga’s “France” joke disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 粉末の匂い
findings.governingReading: smells faintly of powder—read “instant”
findings.explanation: The written powder smell and ruby judgment “instant” collapse into generic instant food.

findings.evidenceJa: 食道
findings.governingReading: esophagus
findings.explanation: The imagined heatproof coating belongs to Taiga’s esophagus, not her throat.

findings.evidenceJa: マーガリンを塗りたくる
findings.governingReading: slathers margarine all over it
findings.explanation: Taiga’s excessive, characterizing application becomes neutral placement.

findings.evidenceJa: さっくり、と音をたてて
findings.governingReading: bites into her toast with a crisp crunch
findings.explanation: The small sensory beat establishing Taiga’s untroubled normality disappears.

findings.highlight: makes me feel like I can trust her
findings.evidenceJa: 大船に乗った気分
findings.governingReading: makes me feel as secure as if aboard a great ship
findings.explanation: A conventional image of complete reassurance becomes a direct judgment of Taiga’s trustworthiness.

findings.evidenceJa: 少し遅くなるけど昼飯時には戻ってくる
findings.governingReading: I will be back around lunchtime, though lunch will run a little late
findings.explanation: The promised meal’s slight delay disappears and becomes a firm on-time deadline.

findings.highlight: it doesn’t hurt, so there’s no problem
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みはないしちゃんと動く
findings.governingReading: there is no pain and it still moves properly, so there is no problem
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits the second piece of evidence Shirou uses to rationalize concealing his condition.

findings.highlight: I can’t tell Saber about such a thing
findings.evidenceJa: 報告して心配がらせる事でもない
findings.governingReading: this is not something worth reporting to Saber and making her worry over
findings.explanation: Shirou’s deliberate judgment that disclosure is unnecessary becomes an inability to tell her.

findings.evidenceJa: 抗議の声
findings.governingReading: the voice of protest—read “Saber”—behind me
findings.explanation: The narration’s visual joke writing “voice of protest” under the Saber reading becomes a plain possessive.

findings.evidenceJa: 感覚のない体を引きずって歩く
findings.governingReading: drag an insensate body along as I walk
findings.explanation: The alien burden of hauling a body that no longer feels like his own becomes ordinary walking while numb.

findings.highlight: took that hammer-like blow to her chest
findings.evidenceJa: 胸に受けて咳き込んでいた
findings.governingReading: took Kuzuki’s hammerlike blow to the chest and was left coughing
findings.explanation: The visible respiratory consequence used in Shirou’s comparison disappears.

findings.highlight: I didn’t actually take a hit
findings.evidenceJa: 実際に傷を負っていない
findings.governingReading: I have not actually suffered a wound
findings.explanation: Shirou denies injury, not that any harmful event reached him; “no hit” erases his severe internal magical backlash.

findings.evidenceJa: 幽霊になったような不確かな足取り
findings.governingReading: uncertain footing as though I had become a ghost
findings.explanation: Unreliable balance and Shirou’s sense of bodily unreality collapse into a decorative adjective.

findings.evidenceJa: 気が滅入る
findings.governingReading: wears down my spirits
findings.explanation: The prolonged numbness’s depressive psychological weight becomes ordinary concern.

findings.evidenceJa: 大きな動きはなかったんだろう
findings.governingReading: probably nothing major has happened
findings.explanation: Shirou’s self-serving inference from Rin not approaching him becomes certainty.

findings.evidenceJa: 和室に聞こえるぐらいの大声
findings.governingReading: call out loudly enough to be heard in the Japanese room
findings.explanation: The purposeful volume and expected listener location disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: たら鍋
findings.governingReading: cod hot pot
findings.explanation: A normal dish name becomes malformed English.

findings.evidenceJa: 鶏肉の照り焼きをメインにした献立
findings.governingReading: a menu built around teriyaki chicken as the main dish
findings.explanation: The menu structure and Shirou’s clattering preparation disappear.

findings.highlight: first time I’ve done something like that
findings.evidenceJa: 皿を割るなんて初めてだ
findings.governingReading: This is the first time I have ever broken a plate
findings.explanation: A precise breach in Shirou’s household competence becomes an unspecified kind of mishap.

findings.evidenceJa: 感覚がズレている
findings.governingReading: my sense of its position is still misaligned
findings.explanation: The dangerous mismatch between intended and actual hand movement is again reduced to numbness alone.

findings.evidenceJa: 俄然やる気が出てきた
findings.governingReading: A sudden surge of motivation takes hold
findings.explanation: The abrupt comic boost caused by Saber’s expectation becomes a comparative increase in enthusiasm.
